title: EDL
description: DRAFT — Edit Decision List. This is the shape of the `edl` field inside the DynamoDB `Edit` item from .kiro/steering/architecture.md (`jobId, editId, clipIds[], edl(json), status`). Produced by the AI auto-edit engine (Bedrock + effects-library manifest) from one or more approved Clips; loaded by the built-in editor (fork of openvideodev/react-video-editor) as initial timeline state. Edits are data, not renders (architecture.md non-negotiable) — only final export hits ffmpeg-on-Fargate.

clipIds.description: Source Clip(s) this EDL was generated from. A single-clip EDL has one entry; a compilation-mode EDL concatenates several.

width.description: 1080 for the 9:16 export target used throughout the pipeline (pipeline/render.py scale=1080:1920).

segments.description: Ordered timeline segments. Each pulls a window from one source Clip's proxy media.

clipId.description: Which source Clip (see top-level clipIds) this segment cuts from.

sourceStart.description: In-point, seconds into the source clip's own [0, end-start] window (NOT the original VOD timeline).

timelineStart.description: Position on the assembled output timeline.

vodStart.description: Original VOD timestamp (seconds) of the clip start. Enables the editor to expand the clip boundaries beyond the auto-generated window back into the full VOD.

vodEnd.description: Original VOD timestamp (seconds) of the clip end.

cx.description: Horizontal crop center, 0..1 fraction of source width. Mirrors pipeline/render.py's face_crop_x() — median face-center x inside the window when mode is face_track; 0.5 for center.

effects.description: FAST-FOLLOW: the effects-library manifest (architecture.md section 5 — sound/visual effects with name, type, duration, "use when" guidance) doesn't exist yet. This array's shape is illustrative until that manifest is built.

effectId.description: Reference into the (not-yet-built) effects library manifest.

source.description: transcribe_word_timeline = segment-level captions; transcribe_word_karaoke = word-level karaoke with per-word timing in overlays[].words[].

style.description: Real values pulled from pipeline/render.py's build_ass() ASS style line.

fontName.description: e.g. "PingFang TC" (macOS); swap for a Noto Sans CJK TC on Linux render workers.

marginV.description: Bottom margin in the 1080x1920 PlayRes, keeps captions clear of platform UI chrome.

overlays.description: Caption lines with timeline-relative timestamps. When source is transcribe_word_karaoke, each overlay includes a words[] array for per-word karaoke highlighting.

words.description: Per-word karaoke timing. Present when source is transcribe_word_karaoke; omitted for segment-level captions.

hookOverlay.description: The <=12-char on-screen hook line, burned in for the opening seconds. Mirrors render.py's drawtext hook (enable='lt(t,2.5)').

musicBed.description: FAST-FOLLOW: no music library exists yet; shape is illustrative.
